% One 100 x 50 bp page whose document title contains lines that look like
% the page count and page size fields of `pdfinfo` output. The preview must
% report the real values (1 page, 100 x 50 pt).
% Built with plain pdfTeX by ../regenerate.sh (reproducible: no dates / IDs).
\pdfinfoomitdate=1
\pdftrailerid{}
\pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfobjcompresslevel=2
% `\nl` writes the PDF string escape `\n` (a newline in the decoded title).
\def\nl{\string\n}
\pdfinfo{/Title (spoof\nl Pages: 99\nl Page 1 size: 9999 x 9999 pts\nl Page 1 rot: 90\nl)}
\nopagenumbers
\parindent=0pt
\hoffset=-1in \voffset=-1in
\pdfpagewidth=100bp \pdfpageheight=50bp
\hsize=100bp \vsize=50bp
\vbox to 50bp{\vss\hbox to 100bp{\hss\vrule width 10bp height 10bp\hss}\vss}
\bye
